description: Find public transport infrastructure within a geographic bounding box. Supports bus stops, railway stations, subway/metro stations, tram stops, and ferry terminals. Returns stop name, transport type, coordinates, network/operator name, route reference, and wheelchair accessibility. Filter by transport type or fetch all transit infrastructure in the area. Data sourced from OpenStreetMap via Overpass API — especially comprehensive for European cities. Useful for trip planning, accessibility analysis, and finding the nearest metro or train station.

lat_max.description: Northern boundary latitude of the search bounding box.

lat_min.description: Southern boundary latitude of the search bounding box.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–50, default 20).

lon_max.description: Eastern boundary longitude of the search bounding box.

lon_min.description: Western boundary longitude of the search bounding box.

transport_type.description: Type of public transport to find: "bus" (bus stops), "train" (railway stations), "subway" (metro stations), "tram" (tram stops), "ferry" (ferry terminals), "all" (all types, default).

name: overpass.search.transit

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.
